milestone.title: Spec-review surface — condensed, diffable, AC-traceable spec views for humans and agents

intent.outcome: Reviewing a milestone spec is fast and focused: a human (via raul) or an agent (via mp) gets a condensed, review-oriented view of a lean JSON spec — outcome, problem, scope, ACs with coverage and evidence status, open questions, and force-bypass flags — plus an AC-to-step-to-evidence traceability matrix and a what-changed-since-last-approval diff, without loading the full milestone document.

problem.description: Spec review is the #1 pain point of SDD tooling. mp specs are dense structured documents; after M82 lean model and M92 JSON persistence, agents still lack a purpose-built review read path. During the 2026-07-01 review-backlog sweep, reviewing M48 and M62 required hand-slicing JSON. raul ships dashboards (M71) but no spec-review surface; mp has validate/challenge for spec quality but not review reading. This milestone closes that gap after M93 fragment reads exist — review view delegates to mp milestone ac show / --fields projections where possible.

in_scope: raul spec-review view (e.g. raul spec <id>): condensed render — outcome, problem, scope, ACs with coverage + evidence status, open questions, force-bypass flags — not raw full milestone JSON
AC-to-step-to-evidence traceability matrix in the review view, with force-bypassed ACs surfaced
Spec diff: what changed since the spec's last approval/revision (requires lightweight spec revision tracking — spike in grooming)
Agent-side review projection (mp spec review <id> or --review preset) reusing M79 --fields and M93 fragment reads
out_of_scope: Generic JSON projection / filtering / summary primitives (owned by M79)
The post-completion execution review queue (owned by M64)

findings.description: spec_diff omits design_decisions. The module docstring (spec_review.rs:6-7) promises 'diffs the review-relevant spec fields (outcome, problem, scope, ACs, open questions, and design decisions)' and the review projection includes design_decisions (spec_review.rs:64), but diff_spec_fields (line 288) never compares design_decisions between base and current. A reviewer asking 'did the spec change?' who edited only a design decision sees 'No spec changes since baseline' — a silent false-negative. AC-03 is general ('what changed in a spec') so this violates the contract. Fix: add a diff_design_decisions helper keyed by area (or id if present), mirroring diff_open_questions, and call it from diff_spec_fields. Test gap: the only end-to-end diff test (raul_spec_diff_shows_changes_since_last_review) mutates intent.outcome only — no test mutates design_decisions, scope, open_questions, or an AC, so this omission was structurally uncatchable (L15).
findings.author: zcode-review

findings.description: evidence_marks_force_bypass (spec_review.rs:109-111) is a byte-for-byte duplicate of the inline check in milestone_health.rs:130-131: 'evidence.contains("[force-bypassed") || evidence.contains("[step-tests force-bypassed")'. Two copies of the same magic-string predicate. If the marker format ever changes (e.g. '[step-tests force-bypassed]' → '[force-bypassed step-tests]'), one copy drifts silently and the review view disagrees with the health summary for the same milestone. Fix: extract a pub fn evidence_marks_force_bypass in milestone_health (or model) and call it from both sites. Classic L9 (new code duplicating existing helper) + L13 (DRY).
findings.author: zcode-review
